about: What Dotdeck's page integration (src/web/focus.js, focus.css, the page scripts in webview.py) and API client (src/core) need from the OpenDots web client and server. tests/test_contract.py keeps this list in sync with that code and, with OPENDOTS_SRC, checks it against an OpenDots checkout; tools/upstream_contract.py --help explains the kinds. The official OpenDots is checked every day by .github/workflows/upstream.yml.

kinds.class: a CSS class of the page's elements (src/client)
kinds.label: an accessible label (aria-label); ${…} is a placeholder
kinds.text: a visible word or alt text, as a whole string or element text
kinds.hash: a link format of the page
kinds.prop: a prop of a React component, read through React
kinds.bundle: text in the built client (dist/client), e.g. React internals
kinds.route: an API route (METHOD /api/path) registered in src/server
kinds.dialog: a window.confirm/prompt question (the regular expression webview.py matches)
kinds.absent: must NOT be in the client: it would break an assumption
